children: The HR leader brings over two decades of recruitment experience across banking, financial services, technology and consulting

Ritesh Jha has joined KPMG India as Head of Talent Acquisition, bringing over 20 years of experience in recruitment strategy, technology hiring and HR leadership. His appointment follows stints at Lloyds Bank and Citi India, where he led talent acquisition and technology recruitment initiatives. His professional experience also includes FIS, Allegis Global Solutions, Info Edge India and GE, spanning recruitment delivery, workforce planning, executive hiring and talent acquisition transformation.
Jha joined KPMG India in September 2026 and is based in Pune. Before this appointment, he served as Talent Acquisition Head at Lloyds Bank from October 2025 to September 2026.

Earlier, he was Senior Vice President – Technology Recruiting, Asia, at Citi India between June 2023 and October 2025. His responsibilities included global technology hiring programmes, recruitment process automation, location strategy, assessment initiatives and the development of centres of excellence for emerging technologies.
His work at Citi also covered diversity, equity and inclusion, talent branding, recruitment advisory and transformation, with coordination across regional and global teams.

Before Citi India, Jha worked at FIS as TA Head for India and the Philippines and Global TA Head for its business process outsourcing division. From September 2021 to June 2023, he managed recruitment strategy and delivery across India, the Philippines and the US.

He previously served as Director – BFSI Practice, Talent Acquisition, at Allegis Global Solutions from May 2018 to September 2021. His responsibilities included scaling recruitment delivery, developing talent acquisition capabilities and advising on transformation through automation, digitisation, branding and outreach.
His earlier experience includes roles at Info Edge India and GE, adding to his exposure across technology, financial services and other sectors.

Jha’s experience spans executive hiring, global capability centre recruitment, talent benchmarking, sourcing models, market intelligence and diversity initiatives. His professional focus includes using technology to improve recruitment delivery, talent engagement, employer branding, quality of hires and the candidate experience.

His appointment places him in charge of talent acquisition at KPMG India, where recruitment strategy and delivery form part of the organisation’s workforce requirements across business and specialist functions.

As companies navigate changing skill requirements and competition for specialised talent, recruitment leaders are increasingly involved in aligning hiring models with business needs, workforce planning and technology-led processes. Jha holds an educational qualification from Bangalore University.
